title: Pyne Pod 2in1 Blueberry Ice Prefilled Vape Pods - Pod Salt Edition
description: This Blueberry Ice Pod Pack for the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 Kit offers a crisp, clean blend of sweet berry and brisk menthol. The Blueberry brings a rich, jammy sweetness with subtle tart notes, while the Ice layer adds a sharp, cooling finish that enhances the fruit’s natural brightness. The result is a smooth yet refreshing vape with a gently frosted edge. Each 2ml pod is prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and made specifically for the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 device. The pods click into place magnetically and are compatible with the twist-to-switch mouthpiece system for quick flavour changes. With two pods per pack, Blueberry Ice is ideal as a standalone option or for pairing with other fruit or mint flavours in the Pyne Pod range.
